New York Herald, 25 June 1866, p. 1, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Bremen steamship New York, Captain Ernst,
from Southampton on the 12th of June, also reached
this port last evening. She landed six hundred and
forty-seven passengers.
The news is three days later.
